result.summary: The page appears largely functional, but contains a significant visual layout issue with the bottom-most restaurant card.

issues.description: The bottom-most restaurant card (pizza) is being clipped by the bottom of the viewport, even though there is no indication that it is meant to be scrollable or truncated, unlike a standard feed list where further items are implied.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the bottom padding or margin of the container to ensure the entire card is visible or provide a clear scroll indicator if more items are intended to be below.
